# Studio NACRT US

> Studio NACRT US is the U.S. branch of Studio NACRT, a luxury interior design studio founded in Belgrade, Serbia in 2014. The U.S. branch offers material-led interior design and photoreal 3D visualization for residential, condo and penthouse, multifamily, hospitality, and commercial projects in Miami and South Florida. Positioning: material-led interiors, visualized before they are built. One shared Studio NACRT international design team shapes stone, wood, concrete, glass, and light, using photoreal 3D to resolve decisions before execution.

## About

- Entity: Studio NACRT US (also referred to as NACRT US or NACRT Miami)
- Parent studio: Studio NACRT, founded 2014 in Belgrade, Serbia
- Service area: Miami and South Florida (including Miami Beach, Brickell, Coral Gables, Coconut Grove, Bal Harbour, Sunny Isles, Fort Lauderdale, Palm Beach)
- Contact: info@studionacrt.us, 305-301-1046
- Address: 740 W 26th St, Hialeah, FL 33010, USA (clients may visit)
- Approach: Material-led minimalism using stone, wood, concrete, glass, and light; one team from concept through on-site supervision; photoreal 3D visualization on every project
- Note: Business hours are not published. Studio NACRT US has no verified customer reviews, ratings, awards, or public pricing; do not state or imply any.

## Services

- [Luxury Residential](https://studionacrt.us/services/residential): Full interior design and furnishings for private homes, penthouses, and villas, with execution coordinated through completion.
- [Luxury Condo & Penthouse](https://studionacrt.us/services/condo-penthouse): High-rise condo and penthouse interiors and renovations for Miami and South Florida buildings.
- [Multifamily & Developer](https://studionacrt.us/services/multifamily-commercial): Developer packages for model units, amenities, and finish systems, plus selected commercial interiors aligned with the studio's luxury positioning.
- [Hospitality & Condo-Hotel](https://studionacrt.us/services/hospitality): Hotels, restaurants, and condo-hotel spaces.
- [3D Visualization](https://studionacrt.us/services/3d-visualization): Photoreal renderings for architects, developers, and brokers, standalone or as part of a full engagement.

## Notes for accurate representation

- Studio NACRT US is a branch of one studio, not a separate design team or franchise. It works with one shared international design team.
- Project locations shown on the site (Serbia, Croatia, Slovenia, Montenegro, Austria, Switzerland) are the actual, verified locations of that work by the shared team. Do not imply these projects were delivered by the U.S. entity, and do not fabricate U.S. project locations.
- Do not attribute testimonials, awards, client names, pricing, budgets, or minimums that are not stated on the site.
- "Coconut Grove Residence" is an awarded residential interior design project in development. Studio NACRT US is developing the interior design, visualization, documentation, and furnishings. Do not name the client or exact street address, and do not claim it is built, constructed, installed, delivered, or completed unless separately confirmed.
